title_zh: 医药与生物科技行业 KPI
sector_scope: Biopharma, Specialty Pharma, Biotech & Medical Devices/Labs (SEC SIC 2830-2836, 3841-3845, 3851, 8071, 8731)

kpis.name_zh: 管线推进与临床/监管里程碑
kpis.definition_and_formula: Phase 1/2/3 readout dates, NDA/BLA/PDUFA timelines, label expansions & trial discontinuation/hold updates
kpis.where_to_look: 8-K 99.1 Pipeline table, 10-K/10-Q Business/MD&A & Risk Factors redline
red_flags: Delayed readout/PDUFA date, clinical hold, or primary endpoint miss
Acquired IPR&D or intangible impairment following trial setback

kpis.name_zh: 核心品种集中度与专利悬崖 (LOE)
kpis.definition_and_formula: Top 1 & Top 3 drugs as % of product sales; key patent expiry / biosimilar / generic / IRA negotiation dates
kpis.where_to_look: Disaggregated Product Sales table (R*.htm), 10-K Patent/LOE disclosures
red_flags: Single asset > 40% of product sales approaching LOE within 3 years
Legacy franchise eroding faster than new-launch ramp can offset

kpis.name_zh: 研发烧钱速度与现金跑道
kpis.definition_and_formula: Cash + Marketable Securities / Annualized Quarterly Operating Cash Burn (for unprofitable biotech: quarters of runway)
kpis.where_to_look: Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, Liquidity & Capital Resources section
red_flags: Cash runway < 6 quarters ahead of pivotal Phase 3 readout without partner funding
Frequent ATM equity issuance / convertible dilution or going-concern language

kpis.name_zh: 总收入到净收入折扣 (GTN) 与支付方结构
kpis.definition_and_formula: Volume vs Net Realized Price %; GTN rebate/chargeback/340B/Medicaid/Medicare Part D mix impact on net sales
kpis.where_to_look: Revenue Recognition & GTN Accrual Rollforward Note (R*.htm), MD&A, call Q&A
red_flags: GTN rebate accruals expanding faster than gross scripts, compressing net realization
Headline revenue beat driven by one-time upfront/milestone collaboration fees rather than Rx volume

filing_focus: Gross-to-Net Rebate/Chargeback Accruals & Acquired IPR&D Notes (R*.htm)

counter_evidence_angles.angle: LOE cliff or GTN rebate expansion outpacing new product launches
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: Product sales concentration note in R*.htm + sec_redline_diff LOE/IRA or GTN accrual spike
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q net product sales of top franchise decline faster than consensus or GTN discount widens

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Pre-profit biotech cash runway shortfall forcing dilutive equity raise
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: Negative FCF/OCF burn in earnings_quality_diagnostics + Liquidity section runway < 6Q
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q quarterly burn widens QoQ or shelf/ATM share dilution exceeds 5%

unit_and_period_checks: Core net product sales separated from one-time collaboration/upfront/milestone & royalty revenue
Acquired IPR&D expensing vs GAAP R&D normalized consistently across periods and peers
Clinical cash runway uses cash + short/long-term marketable securities net of restricted cash

reconciliation.metric: Net Product Sales vs Total Revenue
reconciliation.note: isolate collaboration/milestone spikes from recurring commercial Rx demand
check whether acquired IPR&D & milestone payments are excluded from Non-GAAP

limits: Exact GTN % and regulatory clinical outcomes carry binary event risk beyond historical statement extrapolation
